description.narrative: The Projects expected development impact will include: (i) contribution to Türkiyes GDP through capacity expansion and the increased output of higher value-added cement production; (ii) direct and indirect employment creation; (iii) reduction of the greenhouse gas emissions in the cement production of a Company that is the second largest exporter of white cement globally; and (iv) overall enhanced competitiveness in the Turkish cement sector via its adaptation to the requirements of its EU export markets.

The proposed IFCs financing (the IFC Loan) is to be provided to Çimsa Çimento San. ve Tic. A.S. (Cimsa or the Company), a publicly listed cement and building materials manufacturer with global footprint thanks to its operations in Türkiye, Germany, Italy, Spain, USA and Cyprus. The IFC Loan, structured as a Green Loan, will help fund Cimsas multi-year investment program aimed at decarbonizing its plants in Türkiye (the Project). The Project is to be completed by 2027 and comprises (a) modernization investments (including reduction in clinker usage by increased use of additives in cement production); (b) energy efficiency investments (incl. system changes for increased use of alternative fuels and waste heat recovery improvements); and (c) ground-mounted solar panel installations for captive use.
